paite: Gimlim halna ding maitam na bawl ding ahi. Singgi sing in na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Gimnamtui Halna Maitam / (Eks 37.25-28)
english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

paite: Asau lam tong khat ahi dia; azatlam tong khat mah. Asau lam leh azatlam akikim dia, asanlam tong nih ahi ding ahi. Akiite leng akibang in sa khat ahi ding uhi
english: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

paite: Dangka-engtak in na luan dia; atung, asikte leh akiite ah akimvel in dangka-eng in agei vel na bawl ding hi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

paite: Dangka-eng sikkual nih apang nih a ding na bawl dia, maitam pang nihte ah na bulh dia, azawnna zawlte khumna ding ahi ding uhi.
english: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

paite: Singgi sing in azawnna ding chiangte na bawl dia, dangka-eng in huaite na luan ding ahi.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

paite: K'on kituahpihna ding mun, theihsakna tung a om zahngaihna tutphah ma, theihpihna bawm kiang a om puanzak ma ah na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

paite: Zingsang teng in huai tung ahbAaron in gimlim ahal dia; khawnvakte adet chiang in, atung ah gimlim ahal ding ahi.
english: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

paite: Nitaklam a Aaron in khawnvakte adet chiang in, atung ah gimlim ahal ding hi. Na khang na khang un TOUPA ma a gimlim ahi tawntung ding hi.
english: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.

paite: Huai ah theih louh gimlim hiam halmang thillat hiam, tangbuang thillat hiam, na lan ding uh ahi kei. Huai lou in huai ah dawn thillat leng na sung ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.

paite: Kum khat in khatvei Aaron in khelhna thillat sisan akiite ah atat dia, lemna abawl ding ahi. Na khang na khang un kum khat in khatvei atung ah lemna abawl ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia siangthoupen ahi.
english: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”

paite: Huai khit in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Siah
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Azah uh theihna dia kisimpina na bawl chiang in, pasal chih in ahinna tatna sum TOUPA kiang a apiak ding ahi. Hiai ahihleh amaute na sim chiang a alak ua hipi alenlouhna ding ahi.
english: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to Yahweh when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.

paite: Simtel a om michih in tatna sum apiak ding ahi. Mun siangthou sum shekel kimkhat ahi ding ahi. Shekel khat gerah sawmnih a gik ahi.
english: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to Yahweh.

paite: Simtel a omte lak a paisuak peuhmah kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam in TOUPA kiang a thillat alat ding uh ahi.
english: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.

paite: Na kha ua ding a lemna bawlna dia, TOUPA kiang a thillat apiak chiang un, ahaute leh azawngte'n shekel kimkhat sang a tamzaw leh tawmzaw apiak louh ding uh ahi.
english: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.

paite: Hiai bang in Israel suante lemna sum na la dia, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasepna ding in na sep ding ahi; na kha uh tatna ding a, TOUPA ma a Israel suante a dia theihgigena ahihtheihna ding in," achi hi.
english: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
heading: Dal Tuikuang
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Kisilna ding in tuikuang dal in na bawl dia, atunna khete leng dal in na bawl ding ahi. Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah na koih dia, huai ah tui na koih ding ahi.
english: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

paite: Aaron leh atapate'n akhutte uh leh akhete uh tui in asil ding uh ahi.
english: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin sung a alut ding chiang uhiam, nasem dia TOUPA mai a, mei a thillat lan dia maitam anaih ding chiang ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Akisil kei uleh asi ding uhi.
english: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Huai bang a, asihlouhna ding ua akhutte uh leh akhete uh asil ding uh ahi. Hiai tangtawn in amau a ding in dan thuseh ahi dia; akhang-akhang un amah a ding leh asuante a ding nangawn in ahi ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen lai hi:
heading: Thaunilhna Sathau
english: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Gimlim leng kilak inla, murrah tui shekel zanga leh singguithak gimlim huai zah kimkhat, shekel zanih-le-sawmnga sialluang khum shekel zanih-le-sawmnga,
english: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

paite: Singguithak shekel zanga, mun siangthou shekel dungzui in, olive thau hin khat.
english: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.

paite: Nilh theih siangthou in thau na bawl dia, nilh theih damdawi misiamna bang a gawm; nilh theih thau siangthou ahi ding.
english: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

paite: Huai in kihoupihna biakbuk na nuh ding, theihpihna bawm toh,
english: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,

paite: adohkan leh abelsuan tengteng leh khawnvak koihna leh abelsuan chiteng leh gimlim maitam toh.
english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

paite: Haltum thillat maitam leh abelsuan tengteng leh tuikuang leh akhe.
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.

paite: Huaite asiangthoupen hi ding in na hihsiangthou ding ahi. Bangpeuh huaite khoih asianthou ngeingei ding uh ahi.
english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

paite: Aaron leh atapate thau na nilh dia, amau na siangsak ding, siampu nasepna mun a kei a dia nna aseptheihna ding un.
english: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah thu na gen dia, na khang na khang un kei a ding in hiai thaunilh siangthou ahi ding hi.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

paite: Mihing sa tung ah na buak ding uh ahi kei. Akihelkhawm bang in akibatpih dang himhim leng na bawl ding uh ahi kei. Hiai nilh siangthou ahi a, nou a ding in asiangthou ding ahi.
english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

paite: Hiai bangbang a hel a, akibatpih sathau bawl hiam, siampu hilou midang tung a zang hiam kuapeuh amite lak a pan ka satkhe ding, achi," chi in.
english: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”

paite: Huai ban ah TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Gimlimte, singnai, onicha, galbanum leh begaw akikim chiat la in.
heading: Gimnamtui
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.

paite: Hiaite a pan gimnamtui na bawl ding ahi. Gimnamtui bawlsiamte hel bang na hel ding ahi. Chisoh, asiang leh azek a siangthou ahi ding hi.
english: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

paite: Khenkhat na gawizan mahmah dia, kihoupihna biakbuk sung a theihpihna ma ah na koih dia, huai ah ka hon kimuhpih ding hi. Hiai nang a ding in siangthoupen ahi ding hi.
english: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

paite: Na bawl ding gimnamtui toh kisai in, ahelkhawmdan a abatpih nou aituam ding in na kibawl ding ahi kei. Nou a ding in TOUPA mai ah siangthou ahi ding ahi.
english: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.

paite: Agim namtui nap dia abatpih bawl peuhmah amite a pan ka satkhe ding," achi hi.
english: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
